paper_title: Gated Electron Sharing Within Dynamic Naphthalene Diimide-Based Oligorotaxanes
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Angew Chem Int Ed - 2014 - Avestro - Gated Electron Sharing Within Dynamic Naphthalene Diimide‐Based Oligorotaxanes/auto/Angew Chem Int Ed - 2014 - Avestro - Gated Electron Sharing Within Dynamic Naphthalene Diimide‐Based Oligorotaxanes.md

knowledge_points.content: A series of oligorotaxanes ([n]NDIxR) containing one to four naphthalene diimide (NDI) units were synthesized using a template-directed clipping strategy based on dynamic covalent chemistry (DCC).
knowledge_points.evidence: Recently, we capitalized upon a highly efficient template-directed clipping strategy utilizing the concept of dynamic covalent chemistry (DCC) to prepare a series of rigid oligorotaxanes... featuring a precise number of [24]crown-8 rings which encircle an oligoammonium dumbbell.

knowledge_points.content: Naphthalene diimide (NDI) units in the oligorotaxane assemblies adopt a co-facial arrangement with an average plane-to-plane separation of 3.4 Å, which is conducive to pi-pi stacking interactions.
knowledge_points.evidence: Density functional calculations of [3]NDI2R afforded (Figure 2b) the two parallel-aligned NDI units with an average plane-to-plane separation of 3.4 Å... the two co-facial NDI units at a 3.4 Å plane-to-plane distance apart.

knowledge_points.content: The first reduction potential of the [3]rotaxane containing two NDI units (-0.67 V) is lower (easier to reduce) than the [2]rotaxane with a single NDI unit (-0.73 V) due to favorable electronic interactions between the electron-deficient units.
knowledge_points.evidence: The first reduction (-0.67 V) of [3]NDI2R is easier to perform (Figure 4b) than that (-0.73 V) of [2]NDI1R owing to the favorable interactions between the two electron-deficient NDI units.

knowledge_points.content: Electron sharing in these 1D molecular arrays is described as 'conformationally gated,' where thermally driven motions of the rotaxane components influence the alignment of pi-orbitals and the subsequent passage of electrons.
knowledge_points.evidence: Thermally driven motions between the neighboring NDI units in the oligorotaxanes influence the passage of electrons through the NDI stacks in a manner reminiscent of the conformationally gated charge transfer observed in DNA.

knowledge_points.content: Electron-nuclear double resonance (ENDOR) spectroscopy of the singly reduced [3]rotaxane shows a near-perfect one-half reduction of the hyperfine coupling constants (hfccs), proving full electron sharing across two NDI units on a timescale ≥ 10^7 s^-1.
knowledge_points.evidence: The ENDOR spectrum (Figure 6c) of ([3]NDI2R)- shows a near-perfect one-half reduction of the hfccs established by ([2]NDI1R)-... This observation provides conclusive evidence that the unpaired electron is being fully shared across two NDI units.

knowledge_points.content: Cyclic voltammetry reveals that increasing the number of NDI units in the oligorotaxane stack leads to the splitting of the first reduction wave into discrete one-electron steps, indicating electronic communication between the units.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure 4... reveals a separation of the first one-electron process observed (Figure 4a) in the case of [2]NDI1R into x discrete one-electron steps as a result of the electronic communication between the NDI units in the arrays.

knowledge_points.content: DFT calculations (B3LYP-D3/6-31G**) of the mono-reduced radical anion ([3]NDI2R)- demonstrate a singly occupied molecular orbital (SOMO) that spans across both NDI units in the assembly.
knowledge_points.evidence: Populating the molecule with an additional single electron to form the mono-reduced radical anion ([3]NDI2R)- generates a SOMO (Figure 3) spanning both NDI units which suggests that the unpaired electron is shared within the [3]rotaxane.

knowledge_points.content: In higher-order oligorotaxanes ([4]rotaxane and [5]rotaxane), ENDOR data indicates fractional electron sharing, suggesting that dynamic motions and imperfect pi-orbital alignment create several populations of co-conformations.
knowledge_points.evidence: The ENDOR spectra (Figure 6d,e) of ([4]NDI3R)- and ([5]NDI4R)- appear to exhibit fractional sharing in which the broader linewidths provide evidence of several populations that we suspect arise from dynamic motions... and the partial disruption of pi-orbital overlap.

knowledge_points.content: Variable-temperature 1H NMR spectra show resonance broadening at lower temperatures for [3]-, [4]-, and [5]rotaxanes, indicating an interconversion between different co-conformations and an increased population of co-facial arrangements.
knowledge_points.evidence: variable-temperature (VT) 1H NMR spectra... show slight broadening of the resonances for the NDI protons (Ha and Hb) as the temperature is decreased... implies interconversion between various co-conformations... as well as an increase in the population of the co-facial co-conformations at lower temperatures.

knowledge_points.content: Naphthalene diimide (NDI) is selected for these arrays due to its large pi-surface, n-type redox behavior, photochemical stability, and ease of nitrogen-atom substitution without altering electronic properties.
knowledge_points.evidence: NDI is an attractive functional unit because of 1) its large pi-surface, 2) its propensity to self-assemble into co-facial stacks, 3) its excellent photochemical/thermal stability, 4) its predictable n-type redox behavior and 5) its electronic tenability.
